concrete.feature:
name: Benchmarks

# Every job measures one README table (language, category, bits, size) with all its variants on one runner,
# so that the variants of a table are compared on the same machine. Pull requests run the whole pipeline
# on small sizes; pushes to main publish the results to README.md and README.ru.md.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['rust/**', 'csharp/**', 'scripts/**', '.github/workflows/benchmarks.yml']
  pull_request:
    paths: ['rust/**', 'csharp/**', 'scripts/**', '.github/workflows/benchmarks.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      sizes:
        description: JSON array of sizes (objects skip 10,000,000 and 100,000,000)
        default: '[100000, 1000000, 10000000]'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  report-tests:
    name: Report script tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - run: pip install -r scripts/requirements.txt
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s scripts -v
      - run: npx --yes markdownlint-cli@0.49.1 README.md README.ru.md

  benchmark:
    name: ${{ matrix.language }} ${{ matrix.category }} ${{ matrix.bits }} bit ${{ matrix.size }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 355
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: [rust, csharp]
        category: [links, objects]
        bits: [32, 64]
        size: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.sizes || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && '[1000]') || '[100000, 1000000, 10000000]') }}
        exclude:
          # One million blog posts already take an hour in C#; ten millions would not fit into a job.
          - category: objects
            size: 10000000
          - category: objects
            size: 100000000
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - if: matrix.language == 'rust'
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - if: matrix.language == 'rust'
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: rust
      - if: matrix.language == 'rust'
        run: |
          cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
          echo "BENCHMARK=rust/target/release/sqlite-vs-doublets" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - if: matrix.language == 'csharp'
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          global-json-file: csharp/global.json
      - if: matrix.language == 'csharp'
        run: |
          dotnet build -c Release csharp/SQLiteVSDoublets
          echo "BENCHMARK=dotnet csharp/SQLiteVSDoublets/bin/Release/net10.0/sqlite-vs-doublets.dll" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Benchmark
        run: |
          name=${{ matrix.category }}-${{ matrix.language }}-${{ matrix.bits }}-${{ matrix.size }}
          echo "NAME=$name" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          $BENCHMARK ${{ matrix.category }} ${{ matrix.bits }} ${{ matrix.size }} \
            --directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/storage" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/measured.json"
          machine="$(. /etc/os-release && echo "$PRETTY_NAME"), $(lscpu | sed -n 's/^Model name: *//p' | head -1)"
          machine="$machine, $(nproc) cores, $(awk '/^MemTotal/ { printf "%.0f", $2 / 1048576 }' /proc/meminfo) GiB"
          mkdir results
          jq --arg run_url "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            --arg date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" --arg machine "$machine" \
            '. + {run_url: $run_url, date: $date, machine: $machine}' \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/measured.json" > "results/$name.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: results-${{ env.NAME }}
          path: results/${{ env.NAME }}.json

  report:
    name: Report
    needs: [report-tests, benchmark]
    # Publishes the finished tables even if some jobs failed; the missing ones keep their previous results.
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.report-tests.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.sha || github.ref_name }}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - run: pip install -r scripts/requirements.txt
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: results-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('{0}/results', runner.temp) || 'docs/benchmarks/results' }}
      - if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        name: Check the report
        run: |
          python scripts/benchmark_report.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/results" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          python scripts/benchmark_report.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/results" --readme README.md --readme README.ru.md
          npx --yes markdownlint-cli@0.49.1 README.md README.ru.md
      - if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        name: Publish the report
        run: |
          python scripts/benchmark_report.py docs/benchmarks/results \
            --readme README.md --readme README.ru.md --charts docs/benchmarks
          git config user.email 'linksplatform@gmail.com'
          git config user.name 'LinksPlatformBencher'
          git add README.md README.ru.md docs/benchmarks
          git diff --staged --quiet && exit 0
          git commit -m 'Update benchmark results [skip ci]'
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            git pull --rebase origin "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" && git push origin "HEAD:$GITHUB_REF_NAME" && exit 0
            sleep 10
          done
          exit 1

concrete.feature:
name: cpp

on:
  push:
    branches: main
    paths:
      - 'cpp/**'
      - '.github/workflows/cpp.yml'

env:
  NUGETTOKEN: ${{ secrets.NUGET_TOKEN }}
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
  SCRIPTS_BASE_URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linksplatform/Scripts/main/MultiProjectRepository

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: cpp

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: true
      - name: Setup clang
        uses: egor-tensin/setup-clang@v2
        with:
          version: 13
          platform: x64
      - name: Install conan
        run: pip install conan
      - name: Setup conan
        run: |
          conan profile new linksplatform --detect
          conan profile update settings.compiler=clang linksplatform
          conan profile update settings.compiler.version=13 linksplatform
          conan profile update settings.compiler.libcxx=libstdc++11 linksplatform
          conan profile update env.CXX=clang++ linksplatform
          conan profile show linksplatform
      - name: Instll conan packages
        run: |
          if [ -f "install-local-conan-dependencies.sh" ]; then
              echo "install-local-conan-dependencies.sh exists."
              chmod +x ./install-local-conan-dependencies.sh
              ./install-local-conan-dependencies.sh
          fi
      - name: Test and scan-build
        run: |
          CXX=clang++
          cmake_flags="-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ -DLINKS_PLATFORM_TESTS=TRUE"
          cmake_build_dir="build"
          mkdir $cmake_build_dir && cd $cmake_build_dir
          conan install .. -pr=linksplatform --build=missing
          cmake .. "$cmake_flags"
          cmake --build .
          ls
  pushToNuget:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      with:
        submodules: true
    - name: Read package information
      run: |
        export REPOSITORY_NAME=$(basename ${{ github.repository }})
        wget "$SCRIPTS_BASE_URL/read_cpp_package_info.sh"
        bash ./read_cpp_package_info.sh
    - name: Publish NuGet package
      run: |
        export REPOSITORY_NAME=$(basename ${{ github.repository }})
        wget "$SCRIPTS_BASE_URL/push-cpp-nuget.sh"
        bash ./push-cpp-nuget.sh
  publiseRelease:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: true
      - name: Read project information
        run: |
          export REPOSITORY_NAME=$(basename ${{ github.repository }})
          wget "$SCRIPTS_BASE_URL/read_cpp_package_info.sh"
          bash ./read_cpp_package_info.sh
      - name: Publish release
        run: |
          export REPOSITORY_NAME=$(basename ${{ github.repository }})
          wget "$SCRIPTS_BASE_URL/publish-release.sh"
          chmod +x ./publish-release.sh
          wget "$SCRIPTS_BASE_URL/publish-cpp-release.sh"
          bash ./publish-cpp-release.sh
